_AriaLabelTable.comment: %1$s is the table's name. %2$s is the number of columns. %3$s is the number of rows.
_OptionDateTimeFormatUtc.comment: UTC is an abbreviation for 'Coordinated Universal Time'
_TemplateRelativeTime.comment: Used to express a relative time frame. %1%s is a positive integer. %2$s is the plural form of a unit of time. Examples: "Last 4 Seconds", "Last 5 Months"
_TitleCurrentMonthTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the current month are kept.
_TitleCurrentYearTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the current year are kept.
_TitleCustomTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, a dialog will prompt to let user enter a timestamp range.
_TitleLast24HoursTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the last 24 hours are kept.
_TitleLast31DaysTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the last 31 days are kept.
_TitleLast365DaysTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the last 365 days are kept.
_TitleLast7DaysTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the last 7 days are kept.
_TitleLastHourTimeOption.comment: Used to filter table entries based on Timestamp column. When selected, entries with timestamp value in the last hour are kept.
